sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Identify the correct adjective of comparison: The peak of the magical mountain is the _____ I have ever seen.
What equipment is primarily used to play the traditional game mentioned in 'The Lagori Champions'?
options: A) A bat and a leather ball
B) A pile of flat stones and a soft ball
C) A racket and a shuttlecock
D) A thick wooden stick and a ring
questions.answer: B) A pile of flat stones and a soft ball

questions.question_text: Choose the correct adverb of manner to fill in the blank: The children played lagori _____ in the evening.
In the poem 'The Swing', how does the child describe the feeling of going up in the air?
Select the appropriate preposition of direction: The beautiful river flows _____ the ancient Maheshwar Fort.
According to 'Fit Body Fit Mind Fit Nation', why is it important to exercise regularly?
options: B) To build a strong and healthy nation
C) To avoid going to school
questions.answer: B) To build a strong and healthy nation

questions.question_text: Choose the correct conjunction of reason: We could not climb the magical mountain _____ the weather was extremely stormy.
Identify the correct future tense verb: Tomorrow, the students _____ to visit the historical palace.
What is the meaning of the common idiom 'a piece of cake'?
options: B) Something that is very easy to do
C) A very difficult and tiring task
D) A bakery shop in the market
questions.answer: B) Something that is very easy to do

questions.question_text: Which of the following sentences has the correct advanced punctuation?
options: A) wow what a beautiful mountain.
B) Wow, what a beautiful mountain!
C) wow what a beautiful mountain?
D) Wow what a beautiful mountain,
questions.answer: B) Wow, what a beautiful mountain!

sections.section_name: Section B - Short Answer and Grammar Competency

questions.question_text: Describe what the child sees while going up in the air in the poem 'The Swing'. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Up in the air, the child can see rivers, trees, and cattle over the countryside. Looking down, the child sees the green garden and brown roof.

questions.question_text: Rewrite the following sentence in the simple future tense: 'The children played lagori in the open field.' [20-30 words]
questions.answer: To change the sentence into the simple future tense, we use the helping verb 'will'. The new sentence is: 'The children will play lagori in the open field.'

questions.question_text: Based on your reading of the chapter, name two things the town of Maheshwar is famous for. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Maheshwar is highly famous for its magnificent, historical fort situated on the banks of the Narmada River and its beautiful, hand-woven Maheshwari cotton and silk sarees.

questions.question_text: Combine these two sentences using a suitable conjunction: 'Ravi was very tired. He finished all his homework.' [20-30 words]
questions.answer: We can combine these sentences using the conjunction 'but' or 'although'. The correctly combined sentence is: 'Ravi was very tired, but he finished all his homework.'

questions.question_text: How does playing sports and exercising daily help in building a 'Fit Nation'? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Playing sports keeps our body active and our mind sharp. When citizens are healthy, focused, and strong, they can work hard and build a highly successful nation.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are packing your bag for 'A Journey to the Magical Mountains'. Describe the essential items you would carry with you and explain why. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: I would pack thick woollen clothes, a warm jacket, and strong trekking shoes to stay comfortable in the freezing weather. I would also carry a water bottle, some energy bars, a flashlight, and a small first-aid kit to ensure safety during the steep mountain trek.

questions.question_text: The team in 'The Lagori Champions' showed great teamwork. Describe how players must cooperate with one another to win a fast-paced team game like Lagori. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: In Lagori, one team tries to rebuild a broken pile of stones while the other team tries to hit them with a ball. Players must communicate quickly, pass the ball efficiently, and protect each other. Good teamwork and trust are essential to win the match.

sections.section_name: Section D - Expression and Formal Writing

questions.question_text: Write a short formal application to your class teacher requesting permission to participate in the upcoming inter-school sports championship. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Respected Teacher, I am writing to request your permission to participate in the upcoming inter-school sports championship to be held next week. I have been practicing diligently and believe I can represent our school well. I promise to complete all my missed classwork on time. Thanking you. Yours obediently, [Name].

questions.question_text: Write a short paragraph describing a pleasant visit to a park. You must correctly use at least two prepositions of direction and two adverbs of manner. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: On Sunday, we walked cheerfully towards the large city park. The young children ran quickly through the open wooden gates to reach the swings. A gentle breeze blew around us as we strolled along the quiet path. We spent the entire evening playing joyfully under the tall, green trees.
